# Keyboard shortcuts

| Action | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| Open a file | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>O</kbd> |
| Toggle full screen | `F11` |
| Close tab | Ctrl + W |

- `Ctrl+Shift+T`: Reopen closed tab
- **Ctrl+Tab** switches to the next tab

Press Enter to confirm. Use the Save button (not a shortcut).

[`Ctrl+Alt+M`].
